messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty HIGH - service=inference-prod — p95 latency > 1.0s (SLO=1.0s) for 6m across us-west + eu-west. Auto-page to #eng-oncall.
sara: acked. I'm taking this — pulling up dashboards now.
leo: quick note: eu-west p95 ~1.3-1.6s, p99 ~2.4-2.8s. Error rate looks normal. grafana -> https://grafana/redwood/d/abc/inference?orgId=1
oncall-1: any quick fallbacks? model variant / dedicated pool routes?
sara: initial plan: divert some traffic to dedicated GPUs and check KV cache hit-rate. Starting a 10% -> 50% split to dedicated now. command: `curl -X POST https://infra-api/route -d '{"split":{"dedicated":0.5,"hosted":0.5}}'`
leo: observed KV cache hit drop in eu-west (~20% lower). sounds like cold-prefix churn. I'll trigger a warm for top hotkeys.
ben: if warm cache doesn't stabilize p95, we can rollout q4 quantized small-seq variant for latency-critical routes. prepping rollout script.
incident-bot: incident-bot: ack recorded by sara at 1768524695. Will auto-escalate to ben in 10m if no recovery.
sara: split applied -> us-west p95 improved to ~1.05s, eu-west still ~1.25s. kicking off targeted drain of node-17 which shows GC spikes. cmd: `kubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
oncall-1: infra confirms node-17 has high GC/oom churn, starting drain and replacement.
leo: after drain and cache-warm, eu-west p95 dropped to ~0.98s; p99 dropping too but still a bit noisy.
sara: reducing dedicated split to 30% to balance cost and stability — monitoring.
ben: noted customer impact: some EU premium customers saw transient 10-30% latency increase for ~8m, no errors. I'll own follow-ups: 1) investigate eviction/TTL patterns 2) GC tuning on long-seq pods 3) sticky routing to warm caches.
eng-sre: do we need outbound customer comms?
sara: creating incident report and customer outreach draft now, will link once ready.
ben: filing a JIRA for follow-ups and assigning to infra + runtime teams.
sara: resolving PagerDuty alert and silencing related Grafana rules for the next 30m while we validate. marking as mitigated — leaving for postmortem write-up. :white_check_mark:
